user.title: GitHub Card
user.description: Adds the GitHub panel to the sidebar (administrators only), to follow your repositories in the GitHub integration, and the GitHub cards to your dashboards.

abort.single_instance_allowed: GitHub Card is already set up.

options.title: GitHub

options.not_loaded: The GitHub integration is not loaded ({state}): the followed repositories are listed, following new ones needs it loaded.
options.offered_error: The GitHub integration could not list your repositories (connection or GitHub API limit). Try again later.
options.confirm_unfollow: Stop following {repo}? Its sensors and their history are removed from Home Assistant.
options.skipped: Not offered by the GitHub integration: {names}
options.s_filter_hint: Name patterns separated by commas, e.g. juju35/ha-*. Empty: all of them.
options.s_starred_hint: Besides the repositories of your account.
options.s_archived_hint: Archived repositories are not offered. Followed ones stay listed.
options.s_notify_hint: A Home Assistant notification for each new issue or pull request of the followed repositories.
options.no_issues: No open issue in the followed repositories.
options.no_pulls: No open pull request in the followed repositories.
options.no_followed: Follow repositories in the Repositories tab to see their issues and pull requests here.
